summary: Manual extraction for rakudai-kishi-main vol-09's six listed chapters. The volume covers Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival day two from Ikki's 0.8-second second-round win over Byakuya, through Shizuku's tactical win over Momiji, the infirmary confrontation where Itsuki proposes severing ties with Ikki, the shopping/infant interlude that reveals Sara Bloodlily's artist backstory, and the evening third-round matches. Ouma brutally defeats Renji Kaga and advances to face Stella. Ikki resolves his father conflict, then defeats Sara without Ittou Shura by exposing the limits of Fantasia Art, cutting down her copied Edelweiss and overcoming her final Mario Rosso soul-image. The volume ends with Shizuku found impaled in the waiting room while Amane laughs, setting up Ikki's nightmare semifinal.
notes: Only character and event files were created per p1-scan instruction.
Chapter 6 is author afterword; no in-world character/event extraction was added from it.
The source text headings label these chapters as 第七卷 while the delegated source path and output target are vol-09; the curation volume follows the delegated vol-09 path.
No abilities/items/locations/factions/systems/knowledge files were created in this pass. Ability names and mechanics are captured inside character/event records where directly relevant.
